title: A pi calculation that went wrong at digit 528

probes.question: Which digit of Shanks's calculation of pi contained the mistake?
True or false: the error in Shanks's digits was detected in 1946.

image.alt: A colourful disc made of tens of thousands of tiny coloured digits of pi arranged in concentric rings on black

body.question: In 1873, William Shanks added 100 more digits to an earlier calculation of pi. How many digits had he calculated in total?
body.reveal: In 1853, William Shanks calculated π to 607 digits, but made a mistake in the 528th digit, rendering all subsequent digits incorrect. He calculated an additional 100 digits in 1873, bringing the total up to 707.
